title: PG-03.4 Cross-language protocol vectors (crdt-merge-ts)
request: Programme contract for work package WP03 in crdt-merge-ts: Cross-language protocol vectors. Supersedes PG-03.2 (signed; the PG-03.2 file is unchanged and stays on record, and the manifest and RECONCILIATION mark it superseded by this contract). Reason: the signed PG-03.2 cannot be met as scoped because the TypeScript edition lacks the features its vectors need (ORSet tombstones and element_types, and AgentState); the signer decided to supersede it with a contract that builds them. Depends on contracts: PG-03.1 (signed). The Python serialisation is that of crdt-merge main 252c93e6; the canonical form and vectors are those of crdt-merge pull request #183 (commit aab0099, crdt-merge main at the time of writing; b92d0ef, the commit of pull request #183, is an ancestor of it and the vector files are byte-identical at both). Implemented by the draft pull request #1 of the edition repository; no head sha is pinned. Proposed and unsigned; the signer signs it after the red-team gate. Source: the programme decomposition of 31 Oct 2026 (docs/scope-one/programme/WBS.md, docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md, docs/scope-one/programme/fragments/WP03.json) and the owner notes behind docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md. Depends on tasks outside this contract: WP03-01. Covers only what the Scope One contracts (SO-1.01 to SO-1.11) do not already cover; the mapping is in contracts/programme/manifest.json.   Owner decisions of 31 Oct 2026 apply: crdt-merge stays in its own repository and is reached only across the WO-05-A call-out boundary (never vendored, no memev-merge); tiers are free core, Personal at $12/month or $120/year for up to 3 computers, and contact us above that; there is no Federated tier.

tasks.title: ORSet tombstones and element_types, LWWMap liveness and the canonical form in the TypeScript edition
requirements: MV-DEM-06: Python, Rust and TypeScript nodes exchange identical protocol representations (P2). (source: owner notes of 31 Oct 2026, docs/scope-one/programme/REQUIREMENTS.md:74; evidence docs/scope-one/programme/DECOMPOSITION.md:111; baseline 8.5)

The Python serialisation to match is that of crdt-merge main 252c93e6 (ORSet tombstones from pull request #180, merged through pull request #181); the canonical form and the vectors are those of crdt-merge pull request #183, pinned at commit aab0099 (crdt-merge main at the time of writing, which holds pull request #183; b92d0ef is an ancestor with byte-identical vector files) in tests/vectors/SOURCE (source: crdt-merge main aab0099; crdt-merge pull request #183; contract PG-03.1, cited by id)

Vector numbers are never whole-number floats and never use exponent notation: TypeScript prints 5 where Python and Rust print 5.0, and cross-language float printing is out of scope (normative, owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)

LWWRegister merge: a higher timestamp wins; on equal timestamps the greater node_id wins. Equal timestamp and equal node_id is a known open gap: the Python reference keeps self and Rust keeps other, so merge is not commutative there. That case is excluded from the vectors and must not be asserted; it is recorded in docs/scope-one/RECONCILIATION.md as an open follow-up against the crdt-merge reference, which is fixed first and the editions follow (normative, owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)

An unknown element_types name is read as a string, matching the reference. A typed Rust ORSet<String> may reject typed elements on read; that is allowed and must be documented (normative, owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)

Canonical order: object keys and set members sort by Unicode code point. The TypeScript UTF-16 comparison differs only for astral characters, which the vectors exclude; that is a known limitation and is noted in the edition (normative, owner delegation, 1 Nov 2026)
tasks.description: Repo: crdt-merge-ts. ORSet in src/core.ts records tombstones when remove() runs, keeps the type of a non-string element in element_types, and a stale replica cannot resurrect a removed element. LWWMap liveness and tombstone merging follow the reference, and an LWWRegister tie is settled by the greater node id. src/canonical.ts holds the canonical form of crdt-merge pull request #183 (sorted keys, two-space indent, trailing newline, sorted or_set tag lists). Jest runs from tests/.

criteria.statement: The ORSet tombstone, element-type and LWWMap tests fail before and pass after

tasks.description: Repo: crdt-merge-ts, on Node 22. tests/vectors/ is copied unchanged from crdt-merge at the commit pinned in tests/vectors/SOURCE (aab0099, crdt-merge main, which holds pull request #183): SOURCE, orset.json, lwwmap.json and agentstate.json.
